description: Build script for running rialto unit tests, including test suite configuration, execution, and coverage reporting.

methods.name: runcmd
methods.description: Executes a command with subprocess.run, handling errors and exit codes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and orchestrate build and test execution.

methods.name: strOfKeys
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of suite info into a comma-separated string of keys.

methods.name: getSuitesToRun
methods.description: Determines which test suites to run based on user input, defaulting to all.

methods.name: buildTargets
methods.description: Configures and builds test targets using CMake and Make.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs the specified test suites, with options for listing, filtering, valgrind, and coverage.

methods.name: AddValgrind
methods.description: Constructs the valgrind command with appropriate options for leak checking and suppression.

methods.name: generateCoverageReport
methods.description: Generates code coverage reports using lcov and genhtml.
